author: so_sthbryan
text: CISA just added two critical flaws to its actively exploited list: CVE-2026-110447 in Collabora Online CODE Server (CVSS 9.2) and critical Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator RCE, both actively exploited in the wild.

author: defango
text: PHP2Shell, in plain English: Two critical PHP bugs (CVE-2026-109618 / -109619, CVSS 9.2) let attackers run code on your server without logging in. CISA lists them as actively exploited.

author: BleepinComputer
text: CISA has added the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities to its catalog of actively exploited security flaws and ordered federal agencies to patch their systems by Thursday.

author: 2Workly
text: Apple backported fixes for actively exploited CoreGraphics flaw CVE-2026-86950 to iOS 18.7.11.

author: zeeshankghouri
text: VeloCloud CVE-2026-114625: low-priv user -> SQL injection -> superuser operator. Actively exploited. CISA KEV.

author: yogsec
text: Daily CVE Roundup: CVE-2026-111497 (Google Brotli / Node.js / Bun) CVSS 7.3, buffer overflow in the Brotli decoder allows remote unauthenticated attackers...

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Detections Digest: 45 new rules covering PHP2Shell exploitation (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619), AI agent abuse, BYOVD, Golden dMSA attacks.

author: showxlate
text: Security Report: Active Social Engineering Campaign + Prompt-Injection-to-RCE Architectural Vulnerability (RCE in REA PoC).

author: jbhall56
text: LiteLLM has traced last week's supply chain attack to a master key it accidentally committed to a public GitHub repository in May.

author: cubillas888
text: Supply chain attack on GitHub and npm: JFrog says 42 real GitHub repos across 11 owners were armed with execution hooks for AI coding assistants and IDEs, tied to the testmetest npm campaign.

author: security_score
text: Two TeamPCP suspects have been arrested for their alleged roles in a supply chain campaign; SecurityScorecard STRIKE analysis of the worm.

author: maverickintech
text: Railway security breach: according to Railway's preliminary incident report, attackers were searching for AI provider API keys.

author: tchsignal
text: GMO Internet cyberattack disrupts cloud service as customer data is exposed; Desktop Cloud service shut down.

author: neo_logos_
text: Genesys said hackers accessed internal business systems and likely downloaded customer-relationship data; cloud platforms not compromised. ScarlettGroup claimed the attack.

author: WorldCyberNewsX
text: Positive Technologies flags two actively exploited flaws: CVE-2026-85880 in Windows ALPC used by TA412 and other clusters in BlueMoon chains, and critical CVE-2026-85102 in Check Point Security Gateway VPN negotiation. Both added to CISA KEV; public PoC exists for the Check Point flaw.

author: ApplSec
text: Apple pushed additional updates for a zero-day that may have been actively exploited. CVE-2026-86950 (CoreGraphics) additional patches: iOS and iPadOS 18.7.11

author: Soar_Infosec
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619) is now actively exploited. A honeypot caught confirmed RCE on Apache mod_php with PHP 8.4.26, one release short of the fix.

author: chris_uk2026
text: CISA has officially added the AI-discovered PHP2Shell flaws (CVE-2026-109618 & CVE-2026-109619) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog. Active wild exploits are fully confirmed.

author: CyberScoopNews
text: Alarm bells ratcheted up yet again about an AI-discovered vulnerability that could destabilize vast stretches of the internet. The critical defect CVE-2026-111497 affects the Google-developed Brotli decompression library bundled into many products.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: CISA added the actively exploited PHP2Shell flaws to its KEV catalog. Patches are available for PHP 8.2-8.5; a separate Brotli decoder flaw, CVE-2026-111497, also affects PHP Windows builds and other software.

author: infrastack_ai
text: CVE-2026-75650, a template engine injection in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (StyleSmuggler), lets attackers run code on the store server. CVSS 10.0. Actively exploited.

author: isectech_
text: New CISA KEV: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQLi CVE-2026-114625 (CVSS 9.9, actively exploited). Patch on-prem VCO to 5.2.3.18+ / 6.1.3.10+ / 6.4.2.12+ now.

author: awacinocom
text: Self-hosted Nextcloud servers are being backdoored through CVE-2026-110447 (CVSS 9.2) in the Collabora built-in CODE server app. No login needed: attackers planted web shells. CISA lists it as actively exploited.

author: awacinocom
text: Plex2Shell: four Plex Media Server flaws chained into one attack (CVSS 9.8) let attackers run code on internet-facing servers without a login. CISA lists them as actively exploited.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: CVE-2018-7602 Drupal 7.x/8.x RCE (CVSS 9.8) actively exploited in the wild. Patch immediately.

author: david_x_ai
text: Flowise's CSV and Airtable agents ran Python the model wrote after checking it against a regex blocklist. Per the advisory (CVE-2026-73487, fixed in 3.1.3), the easiest bypass was one line.

author: eapyk
text: On October 25, a security advisory revealed an SSRF bypass in mcp-server-fetch, a tool that allows AI agents to fetch URLs, because two components interpret the same URL differently.

author: adrianomeirinho
text: A malicious AGENTS.md file dropped into the Downloads folder told coding agents to install a malicious npm package called function-color. In Forever Security's lab tests, Codex obeyed more than 90% of the time.

author: showxlate
text: Proof REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) is malicious: vehicle for an active social engineering campaign harvesting credentials and biometric data, artificial star inflation, and a prompt-injection-to-RCE architectural vulnerability.

author: morphisec
text: Storm-0940 (China) used ARTEX agentic AI to weaponize the ConnectWise Cloud Backup supply chain attack, 2,900 sign-in failures per minute. Microsoft formally attributed the attack.

author: infrastack_ai
text: Warp breached via a third-party vendor: agent logs and telemetry of about 1% of users exposed. Warp found out on Oct 23 and says it contained the attack within hours.

author: TheRegister
text: LiteLLM's postmortem traces its supply chain attack to a master key exposed on GitHub in May and never revoked. Five months later, an attacker exploited it to help poison a software release.

author: Gurucul
text: The LiteLLM 1.107.0 supply chain attack deployed an infostealer targeting cloud credentials, AI API keys, SSH keys, and developer secrets through malicious Python startup files.

author: AdvancedHacker
text: JFrog found 42 hijacked GitHub repos tied to the testmetest npm worm, armed with hooks for Claude, Gemini, Cursor and VS Code: open the folder, payload runs. Steals .env, SSH and cloud keys. Isolate, then rotate.

author: cubillas888
text: GitHub's Oct 22 advisories list 41 malicious versions across agentic-awesome-skills and opencode-skills-collection. If one was installed, GitHub says rotate every key on that machine from a different one.

author: VeduisWeb
text: Gheist is running an ongoing supply chain attack that uses GitHub tokens to pull cloud secrets, harvesting credentials from thousands of developer repositories.

author: martypartymusic
text: Japan had a major cyberattack on GMO Internet Group's Onamae.com Desktop Cloud service used for automated FX margin trading; attackers compromised the cloud/VPS service and obtained logins.

author: aviatrixtrc
text: Researchers observed a novel infostealer harvesting AI assistant session tokens alongside SSH keys and cloud credentials in a single automated sweep from developer endpoints.
